format: html

  echo: false
  warning: false

  error: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

# Data and resources
source(here::here("data/clean-data/constants.R")) # Constants
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sed_2022_geometries.Rda")) # SED Summer Hill boundary
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sa1_maps_sh_geometries.Rda")) # SA1 Summer Hill boundaries
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sa2_maps_sh_geometries.Rda")) # SA2 Summer Hill boundaries
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_age5.Rda")) # Age by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tallyroom/nsw_la_2023.Rda")) # Election results by polling place
load(here::here("data/clean-data/digital-atlas/da_housing_sa1.Rda")) # Polling place locations
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_language.Rda")) # Language by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_birthplace.Rda")) # Birthplace by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_religion.Rda")) # Birthplace by SA1

# Merge the SA1 geometries to the tablebuilder data
sa1_maps_sh_age <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_age5[, c("sa1_code_2021", "Total", "Y15to24", "Y60plus")],
            by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_housing <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(da_housing_sa1[, c("sa1_code_2021", "owned_percent", "mortgage_percent", "rent_percent")],
            by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_language <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_language, by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_birthplace <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_birthplace, by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_religion <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_religion, by = "sa1_code_2021")

# Define the colour palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "Greens",
  domain = sa1_maps_sh$Total
)

```


## Population density

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-pop
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill population density by SA1. Source: ABS Census 2021"
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    fillColor = ~pal(Total),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
      "<em>", sa1_code_2021, "</em><br>",
      "Pop: ", scales::comma(Total))
    )  |>
  addPolylines(data = sa2_maps_sh, color = '#6F83A9', weight = 2)  |>
  addPolylines(data = sed_2022, color = "black", weight = 5) |> 
  addMarkers(data = stations, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, label = ~station, icon = train_icon) 
```






## Age distribution

### Younger voters 15 - 24 years

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-age15-24
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill Age distribution: younger voters 15 to 24 years. Source: ABS Census 2021"
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    fillColor = ~pal(Y15to24),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
      "SA1: <em>", sa1_code_2021, "</em><br>",
      "Pop 15-24y: ", scales::comma(Y15to24))
    )  |>
  addPolylines(data = sa2_maps_sh, color = '#6F83A9', weight = 2)  |>
  addPolylines(data = sed_2022, color = "black", weight = 5) |> 
  addMarkers(data = stations, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, label = ~station, icon = train_icon) 
```


::: {.aside}

Because we are restricted to Census 2021 data, the 15 to 24 year olds are 19 - 29 years in 2026. IN 2021, there were 3,330 people aged 15-19 years and over 2,000 of these will be eligible to vote in their first state election in 2027.  

:::

### Renters

```{r}
    data = sa1_maps_sh_housing,
    fillColor = ~pal(rent_percent),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,

      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",

      "Renting: ", paste0(round(100 * rent_percent, 0), "%"))

```

## Language and culture

### Speaks a language other than English

```{r}

#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill: Proportion that speak a language other than English. Source: ABS Census 2021"

  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_language,
    fillColor = ~pal(pct),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
```
